notes.topic: review skills individually, not by recency
notes.correction: Never bundle-demote or disable skills/plugins on zero-use alone; review each one, offer fix-the-trigger, never propose disabling hov plugins.

notes.topic: guard hooks must split compound commands
notes.correction: Shell guardrail hooks must split on shell boundaries rather than anchor at command start; include compound-command test cases.
Use 3-pass median judging, score net-of-deltas, exclude broken anchors, run targeted A/B, and re-freeze suites after batches.

notes.topic: keep memory index under load cap
notes.correction: Treat the ~200-line/25KB index cap as hard; keep descriptions router-only, clear the WARN before parking, add archive tier on repeat hits.
notes.repeat_signal: A project that repeatedly hits the cap

notes.topic: independent verification stages per action class
notes.correction: Run separate fidelity, durability, repo-grounding, checker-check and panel stages; gate every new action class; adjudicate verifier fixes against ground truth.
notes.repeat_signal: mis-bucketed agents in two consecutive passes
notes.enforcer_named: Name==stem is now a build refusal

notes.correction: Hooks gating kill-family commands must parse flag and target grammar, treating negative PIDs after flags or -- as dangerous process-group kills.
Scope verifier prompts per file, stay under 512KB script cap, use distinct splice tokens, resume rather than relaunch, shard long-output agents under 180s.

notes.topic: verify merge premise against live gate
notes.correction: Before merging on 'passed review', re-check live gate output per PR; PR-body pass/fail claims can be stale, so surface conflicts.

notes.topic: measure gated quantity when reproducing flakes
notes.correction: When reproducing threshold flakes, log the thresholded quantity's distribution per run, not pass counts; fix by controlling input, never retuning the threshold.
Mark inferences as inferences in grounding summaries and give at least one skeptic the grounding itself as its target.

notes.topic: stop review loops on advisory heuristics
notes.correction: Before another review round on a warn-only heuristic, measure prevalence and gated impact; if under ~1% or non-converging, freeze and ship with disclosure.
notes.repeat_signal: The same pattern was measured on #1295 (shape-rewrite, 8 rounds) and #1302

notes.topic: fix leaks at shared live reader
notes.correction: When a fixed leak recurs, suspect frozen worktree copies; filter at the live shared reader, count dropped and surviving records, match fixture shape not prefixes.

notes.topic: gh api -f flips GET to POST
notes.correction: Always pass --method GET with -f query params, branch on gh exit code not stdout emptiness, and make test stubs refuse the failing argv shape.

notes.topic: gh merge delete-branch fails in worktree
notes.correction: On gh pr merge --delete-branch exit 1 from a worktree, verify the merge landed, then delete the remote branch via API instead of retrying.
In clones with an upstream remote, always pass --repo on gh issue/pr/api calls or set a default, and confirm title before posting.
Don't rely on undocumented GITHUB_ENV versus env: precedence; write GITHUB_ENV in a later step or use step-level env.
Before marking a PR ready, compare its files-changed count to git diff origin/default...HEAD; if stale, close and open a fresh PR.
Never feed a possibly-empty variable to date -d; guard with [ -n ] at the substitution site, fall back, and warn visibly.
Before writing a repo tool against a harness CLI, ask where it runs; scheduled or CI tools should call vendor APIs directly, keeping CLI as fallback.
Resolve per-file symlinks separately and warn when a default-branch checkout is dirty or ahead, using a three-dot comparison against origin.
When the canonical main checkout is guard-blocked, apply the reviewed change atomically with backup to live config; don't ask a peer to bypass the guard.

notes.topic: add new test suites to CI workflow
notes.correction: When adding any *.test.sh in the repo, add its named step to harness-tests.yml in the same commit; avoid 3-digit # refs in strings.
Create fix worktrees for headless implementers under <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<slug>, or the launchpad advisory makes them refuse to edit.
Run sync.sh reconcile-*-hook only after the hook file is on main and the main checkout has pulled, never from an unmerged worktree.
notes.enforcer_named: `sync.sh` now fails closed on this (`hook_command_target` + existence check, PR #389)

notes.topic: rerun whole compound after hook rejection
notes.correction: After a hook rejects a compound command, reconstruct and re-run every part in order, and verify version files at the release sha before tagging.

notes.topic: snapshot diffs compare identity not bytes
notes.correction: Scope before/after host-state snapshots to the exact drift property (unit names, hooks/mcpServers), excluding volatile columns and self-matching lines.
notes.repeat_signal: four false positives in one onboarding night

notes.topic: inversion probes anchor on unique strings
notes.correction: Anchor inversion edits on a string occurring exactly once, assert the count, and check git diff before concluding a test is vacuous.
Use retired-skills.txt only to delete skills; use skillOverrides user-invocable-only to hide them; confirm intent before retiring and land manifest changes first.
Check the advised fix exists before planning burn-down; freeze with ESLint bulk suppressions; prove class conversions via tailwind-merge with inverted-proof tests.
Choose lint rules by true-positive precision from hand-triaged hits, never frequency or detection fixtures; verify claims that existing rules cover a bug.

notes.topic: budget loop calls for final step
notes.correction: For verification-heavy DoD loops, raise CLAUDE_LOOP_MAX up front or reserve the last 20-30 calls for summarizing and opening the PR.
Before trusting a finding count, plant a known positive in the real repo under the real invocation and confirm it is reported.

notes.topic: claude-domain manifest entries need explicit tests
notes.correction: Add explicit fail-if-absent test cases and install-smoke probes for any manifest entry sourced from the harness tree; generic scan skips them.
Allowlist reviewed paths instead of renaming; avoid quoting token-shaped literals; match checker cadence to daily job cadence or add OnFailure.

notes.topic: merge own PRs, don't hand back
notes.correction: Open the PR, wait for the gate and merge it yourself (use --auto); ask about the change beforehand, never about the merge.
Text-pattern structural auditors must blank nested subschemas before judging each object, with unit tests that flags don't leak across parent and child.
Finish deploys yourself (wt-done activation, ff main, skills-localize) and file the gap; never close with a 'run X' line for the operator.
notes.repeat_signal: why do you keep making me run those commands?

notes.correction: Measure adoption through unsolicited signals such as stars and issues rather than prompted responses.
notes.repeat_signal: Keep prompted responses separate from organic evidence

notes.topic: pin JSON shape across parallel workers
notes.correction: Put literal JSON examples of cross-worker fields in both packets, grep writer and reader side by side, and make readers accept both shapes.
Before concluding throttling for ~90s sample kills, check the predictive_skip no_model_solves hard-skip; correct wrong memory notes same session.

notes.topic: pin checks compare content not SHA
notes.correction: Pin-drift checks should compare content hashes, resolve the blessed version at check time, and skip with notice on API failure.
Don't use pipelines with large producers as conditions under pipefail (grep -q SIGPIPE); use here-strings or capture first; no pattern guard.

notes.topic: instant green PR means empty diff
notes.correction: Before reporting a PR ready, confirm nonzero diff and re-check CI at the final head; instant green on a new PR is the empty-commit check.
Use three-dot diff for PR scope checks and compare merge results (git merge-tree) rather than trees or blobs; two-dot shows main's files as deletions.
Land prod lifecycle changes as draft PRs, run adversarial review regardless of size, wait for explicit deploy approval, and re-verify live state before restart.
On round-2 --confirm output, map each finding to RESOLVED or new before reacting; a FIX-FIRST verdict covers only unresolved new findings.

notes.topic: probes self-poison via argv and env
notes.correction: Assemble query strings at runtime, run probe scripts outside the target dir, and identify the reported holder pid before believing presence.
notes.repeat_signal: three successive probes manufactured their own positive

notes.correction: Wait for explicit 'merge it' and 'yes' as separate boundaries, and inspect the daemon's cgroup is idle and isolated before restarting.
